name: grid-list
title: Grid list
description: Selectable tiles in a responsive grid with arrow-key navigation, tile actions and optional drag to reorder.

when: Items people recognize by an image: photos, documents, cards.

keyboard.does: Move between tiles in two dimensions.

builtIn: Tile actions are always visible, so they need no hover and work on touch.
A drag handle gives the keyboard a way to reorder.
youProvide: An aria-label, and a name for each tile action that names the tile.
